players.product: dedicated bare-metal AI infrastructure (GPU clusters) designed, deployed, owned and operated for enterprises; Axe Compute Build build-to-order program

quarterly_data.signal: Axe Compute 8-K (press release): more than $1.3 billion of new customer contracts across the United States and Europe through the Axe Compute Build program, exceeding its 2026 goal of $1 billion in signed contracts. The agreements are five year commitments with extension options, backed by significant upfront prepayments, and include provisions for ongoing GPU upgrades as newer generations become available; clusters follow NVIDIA reference design. Revenue is expected to begin in late Q4 2026, with prepayments in Q3 2026, boosting ARR to over $384 million upon deployment.
quarterly_data.figure: more than $1.3 billion new contracts; five year commitments; ARR over $384 million upon deployment
